content_types.name: Signal Alert
content_types.desc: A Prophet plan turned into a cashtag post with a price chart showing where we see opportunity.

content_types.name: Chart of the Day
content_types.desc: A single annotated price or macro chart that tells one clear story without commentary.

content_types.name: Plain-English Explainer
content_types.desc: A short thread or post that explains one market concept so a non-professional can act on it.

content_types.name: Macro Note
content_types.desc: A brief plain read on the big picture (rates, liquidity, growth) and what it means right now.

content_types.name: Report Card
content_types.desc: A public update on how a past call played out: the numbers, the outcome, what we learned.

content_types.name: On Our Radar
content_types.desc: A short list of names we're watching closely this week but haven't acted on yet.

content_types.name: Event Reaction
content_types.desc: A fast-turnaround post reacting to a market-moving event with context and what we'd watch next.

content_types.name: Mover of the Day
content_types.desc: The day's single biggest mover, charted, on its cashtag, with the real move %.

content_types.name: Theme Tape
content_types.desc: One post tagged with 6-10 cashtags covering a group that's moving, the reach king at 0 followers.

queue.headline: GDPNow has growth at 5.9%. AI and chips are carrying a narrow tape.
queue.body: I respect the strength, but I’m not chasing leadership this thin.

$LPG 47.4: highest weekly close in 5 years
$LPG 47.1: prior 5-year high
I waited for confirmation and missed the easy part.

accounts.name: Founder's desk — the day's tape, first person

queue.headline: AI and chips are carrying a very narrow tape
queue.body: GDPNow has growth running at a 5.9% annual rate this quarter. I expected that strength to broaden today's leadership. It hasn't, and that bet has cost me.
Michael Stuart Klein opened a new $XIIIU stake with 350,000 shares. I’m logging the buy, not inventing a reason the filing doesn’t give.

accounts.name: Crowd translator — market psychology, mood vs positioning, consumer and tech stories with market consequence

queue.headline: Another $GE streak, and I’m still outside.
queue.body: 5 green closes, capped by a fresh closing high.

I stayed cautious on $CDW and missed the bounce.
Buyers defended 127 again.

accounts.name: Narrative architect — the story that organises the market, the incentives holding it together, and the fact that changes its meaning

queue.body:
Growth: 5.9% annual rate this quarter
Inflation: 2.1% annual rate
Jobless claims: 203 thousand a week this month
I kept waiting for the economy to cool. It hasn’t obliged.

queue.headline: The $CWK story keeps stalling at 14.4
queue.body: I keep expecting a different ending before the chart earns one.

$CUBI found buyers at its longer-term average for the 4th time.
I passed anyway. That precedent is getting harder to dismiss.

accounts.name: Mechanism detective — cross-asset disagreement, what moved first, what is already priced, and the missing denominator

queue.body:
Jobless claims are averaging 203 thousand a week this month.
That's below a year ago, so claims aren't confirming a slowdown.
I was too cautious on growth. Claims haven't earned that caution.

$LPG held the May spike price
$LPG cleared its five-year closing high
I waited for both and missed the clean entry.
The tell was $ARES holding 123 for 23 sessions. I missed it.

queue.headline: $SSPC, base building or stalling?
queue.body: I can't separate the two yet, so I passed. 🔍
At $326, $HII is just starting to move. I’m watching, not chasing

accounts.name: Cross-border correspondent — Asia/HK session, A/H/ADR/FX/commodity transmission, and what New York inherits at the open

queue.headline: I missed the clean $FCX entry
queue.body: 有点晚了 (a little late). $FCX is above 62.7, where trading was heaviest recently. I respect the run, but I'm waiting to see if buyers defend that level.
